content_sections.heading: Anna University Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Anna University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Anna University Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Anna University Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Programme Officer, 1 for Information Officer, 1 for IT/ GIS Officer and 1 for Data Entry Operator.

content_sections.heading: Anna University Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Programme Officer: M.E/ M.Tech in Coastal Management/ Environmental Engineering with 5 years experience. Information Officer: M.E/ M.Tech in Coastal Management/ Environmental Engineering/ Hydrology and Water Resources with 3 years experience. IT/ GIS Officer: B.E/ B.Tech in Computer Science / Civil Engg/ Geoinformatics with experience in GIS software with 2 years Experience. Data Entry Operator: B.E./ B.Tech. or B.Sc. in any discipline, or M.Sc. or M.S.W. from a recognized University/ Institution.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Anna University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Anna University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for Anna University Recruitment 2026 is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the EIACP Coordinator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the EIACP Coordinator posts at Anna University. These vacancies are distributed across different roles within the project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: For the Data Entry Operator post, candidates need to have a B.E./B.Tech. or B.Sc. in any discipline, or an M.Sc. or M.S.W. from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Programme Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Programme Officer position is 45 years. Applicants should ensure they meet this age criterion before applying.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or in person.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the EIACP Coordinator posts?
faq.answer: The monthly salary for the EIACP Coordinator posts ranges from Rs. 16,800/- to Rs. 52,500/-, depending on the specific post and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Anna University. Please check the 'Important Links' section for the direct link.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is temporary, as indicated in the advertisement for the EIACP project staff.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located at Anna University in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600025.
